x: In the 2 miles walk George Oliver made good use of his long mark to win in very fast time with young E. Hall second and our old friend Sid Jarlett in third place.
In the race promoted by Sutton and Cheam Harriers at Sutton on July 27th, three of our walkers, G. Beecham, E.
E. Hall, who is quite a promising youngster, finished second, with Syd Jarlett holding off Harry Shields down the straight to take third place.

Doug Maclean won the 1 mile junior in a new record time of 4 mins. 25.8 secs., and all these fine performances promise well for the future of the club when these lads reach our senior ranks. E. Hall was second in the 1 mile walk and Alan Law gained second place in the weight with 41 ft. 8 ins.
Boreham, while the two back-markers, Maclean and Wright, filled the other placed positions. The 2 miles walk was won by E.
However, we should gain great satisfaction from the fine walking of our Juniors, particularly J. Haynes, E.

The scratch team race developed into a neck and neck struggle, and it was very difficult to forecast who was going to come out winners until the very end, eventually 3 points separated the first 3 teams with us taking 3rd place.. Bob McMullen once again led the lads home in 5th position with George…
And finally a word of thanks to our prize fund donors, Don Brown, Harry Evans, Mrs. Goswell, A.A.Harley, Senior and Junior, E.
Fotheringham of 4.30., won the handicap, with E. Hall (Scratch) 2nd and Ted Smith (1min) 3rd.

With two laps to go, Stan Vickers (50 secs.) who improves every time out, was in the lead hotly pursued by the scratch man E.Hall. They were well away from the field and Hall's superior speed took him first past the post with Vickers two seconds behind.
He was closely followed by Eric Hall and the constantly improving Stan Vickers who had changed from his usual claret and gold to those of the Stock Exchange for the afternoon.
Our scorers at this point being :- 1, S.Vickers; 2, E.Hall; 16, Ted Smith; 17, George Checkley. Bob Newson and Dave McMullen were close behind, followed by G.Beecham, H.McGreechan and J.Coleman.
